name: betcep
label: beta Cep (Alfirk, B1 IV, beta Cep pulsator)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-10-08) and the papers it cites: V 3.23, B1 IV, beta Cep pulsator (P 0.19048 d, 0.11 mag), T_eff 23600 K, R 7.22 Rsun, M 12.0 Msun, d 210 pc
notes: No interferometric diameter exists: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.32 mas from the quoted radius and distance; the Pathfinder would be its first measurement.
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
Radial pulsation period 0.19048 d with a 0.11 mag amplitude: the radius change moves the first null by tens of metres over a night.
Triple: the Be companion Ab (81 yr orbit, ~5 Msun) and the V 7.8 companion B at 13.6 arcsec are excluded here.
Mass 12 Msun adopted for a B1 IV star (the infobox quotes 7.4 Msun for the primary, inconsistent with its radius and gravity).

summary.components: B1 IV, beta Cep pulsator (P 0.19048 d, 0.11 mag)
